statements.t: We expect to continue to pursue opportunities to improve the overall quality of the Rangers and our efforts may result in continued significant expenses and charges.

Income taxes recognized in the combined financial statements and resulting effective tax rates may not be reflective of the taxes that the Company expects to recognize in the future as a standalone entity.

Changes in laws and regulations have limited and in the future could further limit the availability of tax benefits or deductions that the Company expects to claim or otherwise increase the taxes imposed on the Company’s operations.

Management believes that the exclusion of share-based compensation expense allows investors to better track the performance of the Company’s business without regard to the settlement of an obligation that is not expected to be made in cash.

The decisions of the Company as to the use of its available liquidity will be based upon the ongoing review of the funding needs of the business, management’s view of a favorable allocation of cash resources, and the timing of cash flow generation.

estimates.t: The estimates of the fair value of the Company’s reporting units are primarily determined using discounted cash flows and comparable market transactions.

estimates.name: Identifiable Indefinite-Lived Intangible Assets
estimates.t: Under the quantitative assessment, the impairment test for identifiable indefinite-lived intangible assets consists of a comparison of the estimated fair value of the intangible asset with its carrying value.
